segments.text: I'm going to tell you what I use and how I address these patients.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Number one, we saw everybody in person.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So I got to see them face to face.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I'm a face to face doctor.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I'm not a telemedicine doctor.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I have to see disease for myself.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So those who presented with basically just upper URI symptoms, cough, not really cough, but more runny nose, headache, fever, those patients got hydroxychloroquine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We started them on 400 milligrams twice a day on day one.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And then 200 milligrams three times a day, day two through five.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That's number one drug.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Number two, we gave them Zithromax or doxycycline.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And number three, we gave them zinc.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And the zinc was either the zinc sulfate, the 220, or just regular over-the-counter zinc, 25, and we gave that to them twice a day.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We also used vitamin D3, 5,000 units a day, vitamin C, 500 milligrams twice a day.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And we started using N-acetylcysteine, NAC.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Okay?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: 600 milligrams a day.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That was the foundation of our treatment.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: That's what it started.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: If patients had pulmonary symptoms, if they had the chest pain and they had a shortness of breath, we did chest x-rays.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We found early on that the chest x-rays were positive for inflammation.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So what did we do?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: We started treating the inflammation.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So I gave them six milligrams of Decadrone and we started them on inhaled Budesonite in the nebulized form.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I wanted to stay away from the systemic
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: treatment because I didn't want to really suppress their immune system, but I wanted to treat the inflammation.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So that's why we went to the nebulized Budesonite form.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And amazingly what happened was we found in two to three days, 99% of our patients were better.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
